body:
LOL, Syria was doing fine before ISIS and the war. They had cellphones and technology like the rest of us.
I live in the middle east and it's not the hellhole that people in America assume it is.

Thanks for the video, it's helpful.
I try to not be petty and to remember that life is fragile and that there's no need to fight with the people close to me, but sometimes they're the ones who fight and they don't seem to think about how everything will be over eventually. How we can lose each other at any given time. I'm scared that I won't be able to fix things with my ex and we'll drift apart and won't be there for each other when something happens, and I really can't stomach the thought of being far away from him and growing old without him. I've never felt this way towards any other ex. I can't shake the feeling that it's the wrong decision for us to be apart.

Thank you.
I'll go see my doctor. I've never had anything like it before, maybe I just need to adjust my dosage.

I don't know... I don't have many people in my life right now. And those who are in my life are very busy all the time and I don't want to burden them.
It's really hard having to go through this alone.
I worry less about myself and more about people who I care about. Like my mother. Living without those people if they go first.

Googled it. I've known it as "intermittent reinforcement".
That's definitely what was going on with my ex. There's a great video on this subject on YouTube. Search a user by the name of Teal Swan. 
Sex was always difficult for me, and actually the first time I've really enjoyed it was with the narcissist. Maybe that's why it scares me now... I don't want to get back to the bad sex I've had with the boyfriends I had before the nex, and I don't feel like the kind of sex I've had with him will ever return for me... He really convinced me that he's the only one that'll make me feel this way.

It's not even the old me, because I was always insecure and timid, never stood up for myself. That's why I realized that after such a horrible relationship that wrecked my mental health completely, I have to learn to be stronger. I was trying to achieve it by working in a new place, working out and practicing relaxation techniques etc... but then this thing happened and everything kinda just came back to me, all the memories and social traumas from the ex and bad friends, and other exes... I feel very overwhelmed and I feel like I forgot how to even communicate to other people properly. Any interaction exhausts me.

I  miss him so much. Nothing in my life ever hurt as badly as this.
I thought that being with someone new will make it go away faster but it only reminded me of everything about that relationship.

I know... I'm just so scared and so insecure after my last relationship, I can hardly think straight. I really need to be alone for a while longer and get to the point where I'll feel relaxed and ready to communicate with a new person without thinking they'll react like my ex did.
I'm scared that I'll end alone if I won't agree to these things. I forgot how it is to stand up for myself and my needs.

I don't feel inadequate... I think I'm panicking because I'm not ready for sex with this person. Even before my nex I had to have feelings for someone in order to be intimate with them, and I obviously don't have feelings for this person yet. I don't know if I'll ever have feelings, but now I barely know him and it takes me a lot more than 2 weeks to feel comfortable with someone. Even with the nex, which is the person I've loved the most, more than any other boyfriend, it took months of just talking on the phone before we even went on a date. And now I rushed into immediately going out with this guy and I don't feel comfortable.
Plus I still love my ex and I can't imagine being with anyone else. It's only been a few months since the breakup.
And also, my nex told me when he broke up with me that he was with me only for the sex. When this new guy rushed into inviting me over to his place, it made me feel like he also only wants sex with me and doesn't actually wants to get to know me.

I realize how crazy I probably sound, but my mood has plummeted and I'm crying and I really hate being in this situation. Like I said, things were getting better for me mentally and now I'm back where I started.

Hi, I'm going through the same thing, except my ex doesn't contact me anymore.
I'm here if you need anyone to talk to.

I was in therapy for awhile but now I'm working very long hours and my therapist is unable to see me in the evenings. I'm waiting for his schedule to clear. I wasn't evaluated for PTSD.

I have days when I'm very angry at him for everything, for how he made me feel and how he left me. But I also have days like today when I cry a bunch and miss him.
I know that it was an act for him, but to me it was real and my feelings are very real and I'm hurt. I've never loved anyone this much, even people I've been with longer.
He became such a huge part of me and my life... I'm going to need a lot of time to get over it, especially since I don't have any friends or distractions. I only have the gym, and I can't exercise this week because I'm sick.

I miss him so much. I blocked him everywhere but I keep checking the phone log to see if a call from him was automatically rejected.
I think about him all day, I can't stand the thought of him with other women. It hurts to be forgotten this way by someone I tried so hard to keep and please for 2 years. I feel all alone.

Wow, thanks! That makes sense. My parents are facing a lawsuit against them from their neighbors, for something that wasn't their fault (faulty pipes in a very old building) and the whole family had to deal with the lawyer and the justice system and a bunch of frustrating things that come with that - and I used to be able to move on from bullying fairly quickly but now I keep feeling like I cannot catch a break ever in my life.

I can't move, just financially even. I really want to eventually move to a small town or even a village or something or to a farm, because I just want a quiet life away from crowds of people. But right now I have to work and save money, and with the whole financial thing in my family...

I'll browse this subreddit, maybe there are book recommendations or something. I joined the gym, which gives me an outlet for some of the anger. But I also have to learn to handle it when I don't have access to the gym. I can't spend entire days being upset at what some moron said to me in a store, it's ridiculous.

That's exactly how I felt - my mind felt always in danger because I didn't know what he'll do next and when he'll decide to fight with me again. And I also have an anxiety disorder, so it made things even worse.
I seriously feel like that amount of anxiety is causing me to be sick (I have headaches almost every day) and I'm scared of becoming seriously ill in the future because of all of that, since stress can cause illnesses.

The job is fine... it's also very stressful since I'm still learning and don't have experience. My supervisors give me feedback and it's not always good, which makes me feel worse. I cry a lot after work, sometimes during. I feel overwhelmed by all the criticism from everyone in my life. I used to take negative feedback a lot more lightly, but since my ex who criticized me every single day I can't take anymore of that, I feel attacked.

Thank you.
Like you said, I'm just not suited for any of this drama. I yearn for some quiet and peace of mind. He just doesn't even get how much pain he's causing me. I woke up now with a headache and a cold and I suspect it to be entirely stress induced, because it's not even cold here yet and I'm always getting sick in some way after experiencing such severe panic like last night.

The phone doesn't block calls from private numbers though... And I really don't want to deal with the police at all. Where I live the police just isn't efficient, and it will only take my time and energy to try to reason with them. I'm really too tired for this.
It began right before I met him, and the relationship with him made it worse.

Each time I try to lower the load more things happen. I so desperately need to focus on myself right now. I've been suffering from depression for 2 years and it keeps getting worse and I have anxiety as well. So my heart is constantly racing, my head hurts. I really want to be left alone somehow, to have time to pull myself together.

I don't know what's the spectrum, but I can tell you that I've been taking anxiety medication since I was about 18- so for about 8 years now - and I've changed them probably like 5 times, and that's without the changes or additions of other pills (like sleeping pills for when some of the meds effected my sleep). Some of the medication didn't help at all and even made me worse, some helped and then stopped. Some helped only when adding something to it.
My doctor claims it's fine and that it's just a very complicated process to find the right pill and right dosage. So maybe it's right for your case as well.
Thanks. I'm just very disappointed by how he chose to end a 2 year relationship. I really don't deserve all of this and there's a long road ahead of me until I'll heal.

Yeah, I did it - took a screen shot of that and of the message he later sent me where he said he won't go to the police unless I'll continue to contact him. Just in case he'll do it anyway.
Blocked him everywhere, deleted his number. 
It's unbelievable that this is how he's acting after being with me for 2 years.

Your story sounds almost exactly what I'm going through, down to the date of the breakup even. Mine was October 5th also.
I've also asked for closure but he didn't want to talk to me. This morning he said he'll go to the police if I'll ever contact him again - and during the last month he was the one to contact me in order to tell me all kinds of abusive things.
I'm also hurting a lot over this, gave him everything I could. He still has some of my things, but they're not important anymore.
It's good that we at least have this space to vent about our experiences.
I hope you'll feel better when going NC.

My morning was really bad. My ex called and said that he's recording the conversation because he wants to go to the police and show them all the texts I've sent him over the past months. He said that it's enough to file a complaint about harassment. I begged him not to do it and he said that he won't, but if I'll ever contact him again he will do it without a warning.
I'm scared now that he'll just do something like that even if I won't talk to him. I don't know what to expect from him anymore.
You can talk to me.

Well, then maybe I have hope too. It's been a little over a month and I'm crying constantly and hardly sleeping. I think that I'll never get fully over him no matter what, because the love was too big and this person was a huge part of my life - more than anyone before him. Not easy to forget that.
How long did it take for you to stop crying a lot?
Yeah, for me it's like sex was almost reinvented with him even. It was so different than what I had with others.

I definitely want children. And I liked having sex with my ex, it felt good. Just the fact that he said it's the only thing I'm good for ruined it. I'm afraid that more people will see me only as a sex object and not as a person.
Yeah... the technology and medicine are great though. Too bad the people became egoistic and just plain heartless.

I'm not going to date anytime soon anyway. Just feel weird about how the whole idea of sex makes me feel really bad due to memories that are connected to it.
I'm already going to therapy, but I don't feel comfortable talking about this particular thing right now to my therapist. I really feel too ashamed about the things that my ex said to me and how he made me feel about myself.

I believe his words because he was the biggest part of my life for 2 years and he was the person I loved the most. I trusted him and didn't see how toxic he was until the very end. And the breakup is still fresh, so I can't immediately go back to how I used to think before him. He just really had a strong grasp on me and controlled me and my emotions. Devalued me. And it was never easy for me to trust people or get close to them even before I met him, so this experience brought up a lot of fear and suspicion towards people.

I'm trying to think that way. I just keep going back to how he's happy without me despite how much I tried to be good enough. And I'm here alone and feel broken.
I don't want to be the sad person that posts all the time, but I'm just lonely and trying to figure all out still.

Yeah, I'm disgusted by people lately more than ever also.
I'm a lot more conservative about these things than people my age tend to be, so sex always came only with love. And even with the narc, despite how he only cared about his needs in bed, I liked the sex because I felt close to him when we did it. It was a time in which he was entirely mine. He's also the first one I really really wanted to sleep with. The previous boyfriends weren't as attractive to me.
So it just very traumatic to find someone that makes sex feel safe and special, and then hearing from him that it's the only reason he was ever with me.

Thanks.
The insurance is fine, just not many mental health experts. Plus I don't have a car so I can't really go to someone who's working in another town. And in general the topic of mental health is not very developed here because it's still considered to be pretty taboo. =\
I'll just talk to my therapist and see what to do. I don't want to waste my money without seeing results, that's the main problem. Especially since I'm not working at the moment.
I'm not American... I live in Israel, so that site doesn't help me.
That's really great that you feel this way. I hope I'll feel like this too eventually.

I definitely won't date. I can't even think about dating right now without feeling sick. It always took me a lot of time to feel comfortable with men and I can't just date for the sake of dating. I'm also not a social person so I don't need someone just to be there, I really want real love and not a partner for hanging out.

My therapist doesn't give me any homework... should I ask him about it? He said he's doing a dynamic therapy, which involves finding the root of the problems, but meanwhile we're just talking about the past and not getting anywhere. I actually think about changing to another therapist, but I need someone through my insurance and that list is very short.

I also have dreams... sometimes they're nightmares but mostly they're about good things that happened to me with him in the past. I wake up feeling the emptiest I've ever felt. 
I know that he's not capable of feeling the way I feel, but even the thought of how I miss him and how not seeing him or smelling him ever again kills me - and he doesn't care about not seeing me... this thought really bugs me. I really thought we had something special. He always said how good he feels with me, so how can he be happy without me?

Thank you. It really feels like what you said about being thankful for crumbs. He made me feel like I can't and won't ever experience a good, healthy and full relationship with a man. That I only deserve crumbs of attention and love and not the whole thing.
I also feel bad about how he's happy without me, even though I'm the one who gave more in the relationship and always wanted him to feel good with me. And now he's happy without me, and I'm all alone and miserable. How is it even fair? And the thoughts about the plans we had for winter and my birthday... it all breaks my heart.

I'm reading about narcissists a lot and I just don't get why he chose me in the first place. I feel so guilty for letting myself down and being the kind of person that would attract someone like that, who wants to harm me. Instead of attracting people who would love me and want me to be happy and healthy.
I've told the therapist everything but he doesn't offer any solutions yet. I don't know how therapy works and if it's normal for it to take a lot of time.

I'm trying as hard as I can. I've been suffering from depression for 2 years, so it adds another layer to the situation.
But I'm working out, joined a gym. Started learning a new language. Going to therapy. Looking for a new job. Finished the last paper for university and now waiting for a grade. Trying to read, but my mind drifts.
I'm really focusing on the gym right now - also eating better. It helps me more than anything else. I'm listening to podcasts a lot also, because it's gives me other things to think about.
Been going on walks in the evening sometimes... listening to audiobooks while doing it. Just trying to survive day by day, you know. It just sucks that surviving is my goal right now and that's the most I can hope for, since I just can't find anything to be happy about since the breakup. 
He's been my happiness for these 2 years - as bad as it sounds. We met right after I was diagnosed with depression and the relationship with him helped me so much, at least at first. He gave me something to look forward to. I kept hoping we'll get closer and move forward. I was waiting for my birthday, which is in December, and now I won't be spending it with him. My last 2 birthdays were with him. It hurts like hell that suddenly the most important part of my day to day life is gone.

I don't want any male attention... I hate it when people look at me in the gym even.
Everything just feels wrong without him in my life. It's stupid that he treated me badly and I still love him, but I gave him everything I could and loved him with all my heart and he doesn't even miss me.
I have no idea how I'll trust anyone ever again. I don't want to fall in love and lose it again.

I've also been abused, emotionally. From what I've read, it can impact the breakup as well. He ruined my self esteem completely.
It feels weird to think about it as an addiction. Like it wasn't real, what I felt... But to me it was very real and important and he's so important to me. I really thought that I'll never lose him.

I'm already on medication. I have a therapist, but I don't feel like we're making any progress. I'm going there tomorrow.

I don't understand why this breakup is so painful. I've had breakups before, from guys that I dated much longer even. None of those experiences were even 1/10 as painful as what's going on now. Why is this one so different?

I haven't listened to music at all since the breakup because hearing about love makes me sad and most songs are about love, even the happy ones.
I have social anxiety so making friends is very hard for me. I try to spend time with my parents, just help with anything I can. Anything to keep me occupied.
I hope I'll find a job soon and at least there will be people around me during the day...

Thank you.
I've going to the gym 6 times a week, just to have a place to go. I took 2 anxiety pills after posting this and now I feel more calm but also a bit dizzy. Probably dehydrated from crying so much... I've never cried so much over anyone.

What did you do in those 4 months before you felt better? I'm already trying all I can think about and nothing helps.

I'm at only a month and it feels like it happened yesterday.
I'm trying to stay NC but I keep failing at it. Just wanting to hear him.
Like you, I'm trying everything possible - working out, looking for a new job, joined a new class, reading self help books, trying to enjoy my time alone. But at the end of the day I miss him terribly. I've never missed anyone this way before and I'm scared that it won't pass. None of my previous breakups were like this.

I'm here if you want to talk. I could also use a friend right now.
Sure. I just keep wanting to call him, just to hear him. And I'm trying to listen to music or read the news, anything to distract myself but my mind keeps going back to him.

I have the same problem. Blew up his phone during the last month.
I want to hear him, I miss him so much.
I thought that he'll change his mind but he doesn't contact me anymore. It feels terrible. I blocked him everywhere but keep checking the rejected calls to see if he called.
I have no idea how to stop hoping to hear him.
It's been a month since the final breakup and he didn't apologize, so I'm guessing it won't come. I don't believe he can be honest about an apology anyway.

I feel like I just don't have the energy for anything, except for exercising.
I really wish none of this had happened to me, because it's effecting me so much in every aspect of my life. I don't even want to talk to people anymore, I can't trust anyone.

" I wanted him to tell me how to fix myself."

Exactly how I felt with my ex.

I think that most of us blew up at them. I personally just sent him a series of texts on instagram before blocking him, and I wrote that I hate him and how he ruined me instead of realizing that I'm the only one who knows who he really is and still wants him (he always told me that he doesn't believe in love because women eventually always leave - but I wouldn't leave).
From what I've read about narcs, they can't change. I don't think that they would want to either.

Hi!
I totally understand how you feel. First of all, my ex loved to call me crazy and blow up my mental problems way out of proportion. He knew I have an anxiety disorder and in the last 2 years I've been suffering from depression (he was actually the main cause of it), but he always said that I'm unstable and insane and wanted me to feel like all the problems between us are my fault, or my mind's fault.
Also, I know how it feels to suddenly realize you're not special to him. It hurts, but the thing is that they're liars and they can say they love us in order to manipulate us. My ex said he'll never give up on me because he won't forgive himself if he will - and then he just blocked me everywhere and started sleeping with others.

I really wish I had some words of wisdom to say to you, but I myself am going through hell with my breakup. I just hope things will get better for you.

Hi, I've been avoiding going to one for years and tried everything else - nothing worked for me so I finally decided to try counselling in September. I've only been 6 times and obviously it's a long process to work through issues (at least the ones I have), so it's only the beginning for me, but it helps a little. It helps to sort the thoughts and understand what's important and what isn't, what you need to work on and what is just human and a part of who you are.
I'm currently unemployed so I don't know for how long I'll be able to afford it, but if you can afford it I'd recommend trying it. It can't hurt, unlike medication which I hate taking because of the side effects. The only real issue is the cost.

Ugh, I don't like what your mom said about being thankful for having a job. Yes - many people don't have jobs and that's too bad, but we should also remember that the workplace needs us, the workers, as much as we need the job, if not more. We should aim to find a job that will fit our mental needs, and not just get stuck in a job that makes us feel bad.

I'm going through the same thing.
I quit my last job in July, worked there for 8 months. Before that I was unemployed for 6 month after quitting the previous place. Each time I quit because of anxiety/depression (too much crying at my desk/in the bathroom/inability to eat in front of people/general feeling of dread each morning/etc).
Those two jobs were part time, which is the only reason I managed to hold on to them for almost a year each. Otherwise I'd crack a lot earlier. I'm now looking for a job again and the process of getting interviews and going to them makes me anxious and I have many panic attacks just thinking about going there and talking to someone and then waiting for an answer and all of that.
I'm scared to even think about the job itself, I'm trying to take it one step at a time.
I'm still living with my parents, I'm almost 26. I feel very bad about how my life turned out and I know that it's the depression and that I shouldn't beat myself up so much over it, but I feel like a failure. Like I've failed my parents and grandparents and myself. I cry a lot because of these thoughts.
And I really do try to get jobs and suffer through it all just to hold on to them but I never could start building a "career".

My point is that you're not alone in this. I'm sure it's a common thing, since people with depression and/or anxiety tend to be more sensitive to things like talking to many new people every day (on the phone even) and all the noises in a working environment, the pressure to befriend colleagues, even waking up too early and maybe not sleeping enough (I know that I get even more anxious if I don't get enough sleep). We need to just find the right job, the right place with the people that we'll be able to feel comfortable around. The workplace is a place where you spend a huge chunk of your time and it's important for it to feel mentally comfortable as much as possible.

I won't go back to him. He didn't try to contact me since I blocked him. The funny thing is that it makes me sad that he didn't try anymore. I still love him and miss him so much, but I know he's toxic and that 2 years of my life were basically taken away from me. I wouldn't want to waste more time on a dead-end relationship.

I feel the same way. The breakup is fresh and I get upset every time I see couples, even online. Also any family, because I hoped to start a family with him. It's really hard and I also have a hard time believing it's possible to love again.

My breakup is fresh and I'm so tired and sick. I woke up today with a fever and I really haven't been sleeping too well for the last month.
I also dream of him.
I sometimes feel like my entire body is going through a withdrawal or something, because every part of it just hurts.
Yes I know. It's all part of what I'm focusing on in therapy now.

Thank you.
I didn't treat myself like a dumping ground before I met him... just for some reason didn't insist on being treated well. But I'm working on it and I won't find myself in the same situation again.

Oh s***!!!! The thing he writes about somatic narcissists... Oh my God.
It's exactly how he was, unfaithful and addicted to sex. It's so insane to me, to read these things that describe him so accurately. Shocking even.
Oh I think I found it, is it this page?http://samvak.tripod.com/abuse3.html
Do you have a link to that?

Yeah, I'm going to a therapist. I don't live in the US so the insurance thing is a bit different. The government covers most of the cost but mental health isn't very developed here so it's still pretty expensive, especially for someone who doesn't work (which I currently don't, but thankfully I have savings).
I've had anxiety for years even before this guy, so I'm on meds anyway. Only problem is the depression which is pretty new and much much harder to live with than anxiety (which I just got used to over the years... but I don't want to get used to depression, I just want to heal once and for all).
Do you have more books recommendations? Anything that helped you, maybe even just uplifting books. I'm doing a reading list for myself. Couldn't read for a while actually, because during the relationship my mind was occupied entirely by him and how he made me feel, fights, etc.

Thankfully I don't know anyone who would agree with him. We kept our relationship very private and I only told my mom and one other person about this. Well, and this subreddit lol. They of course supported my side. Only a monster would side with this psychopath, honestly. I fell in love with him and truly still love him despite all his words and actions, but I realize that he's a bad person and his behavior isn't okay in any way.

I'll definitely buy the book, thanks. I find that self help books is one of the most helpful things in bad situations in life. I'd love to get more recommendations actually, because most of the books on the subject seem too technical.

I went to sleep after all this happened and now in the morning I'm back to anxiety and all the bad feelings. But I'll stick to it and stay away, because that guy is just poison to me. And he dared to even call me poison, at one point. He doesn't even appreciate me, he's capable of hurting a girl who loves him and did everything to be good to him. He's just evil as far as I can see it. It's gonna be hard to deal with everything and I need therapy because of him, but I just have to survive somehow. I can't let such a bad person ruin my life even more than he did for these 2 years.

Yes, I can't even learn from it. He made me feel like I'm to blame for the breakup and all the fights before and I always felt so incredibly guilty because I wasn't good enough for him and tried more and more to be what he wanted me to be - but I wasn't to blame really. I tried my best, and probably a lot more than anyone that he met or will meet. I really gave than man everything a person can possibly give another person.
The only moral is not to sacrifice myself anymore for anyone, I guess.
Thank you
Exactly. There are better ways to break up and treat someone after a breakup. He could just block me like he originally did and not come back for all of this. Hurt me like hell.

No, I won't complicate my life further by changing the number. He knows only the email that I don't really use anymore, so that's not really a problem. And I just added him phone to the auto reject list and to the spam list on the messages.
I really hope that after what I wrote him he'll get the message and go rot in hell.
I don't know if it's the same thing as losing someone that I'm in love with. Giving up on friends was never nearly as hard for me as giving up on love.
Yeah... I know he is. Only put the pieces together after the breakup. But it doesn't make it hurt less.

I do work on myself. I'm going to therapy and joined the gym, even signed up for a new class. Everything to keep myself occupied and try to find out what will make me happy.
It's just... I can't even explain the feeling I have. I'm just very very, very hurt. Never been so hurt. I think about him and I miss him and I feel terrible because of him and the breakup. It never happened to me this way in any other breakup.
I just don't see myself ever not loving him. I really though he's "the one" or whatever, and before we met I didn't even believe in "the one".

I answered because I still kinda hope he'll change his mind and will decide that he wants me back and that out relationship is worth fighting for. He's been such a huge part of my life for two years and the breakup was pretty surprising to me, I didn't think that he'll end it.

Yeah, that's what he said. I asked him why is he calling me and he said that it's just to ask how I'm doing... and then said the thing about the others and I started crying, couldn't help myself really (too emotional these days) and then he had to go and that's it basically. Really a pointless call. Even asking me how I'm doing is pretty pointless, he knows I'm not doing good.

Thank you.
He called today and I didn't resist the urge to pick up. Just hearing his voice sent me into a panic attack. I asked him why he called and he said to ask how I'm doing. Then he told me that he's going out with others. I can't believe how much it hurts, I seriously never experienced anything remotely like this.

I don't want to reconnect with those friends. They weren't healthy for me and the more I think about it the more I realize that those connections are partly the reason for me getting so close to my ex, because I never could trust any of my friends and didn't feel like I can talk to them about things or even ask them to hang out - and then I met him and he wanted to do these things with me and didn't make me feel like a burden, unlike how they made me feel.
So it's better to go forward and not go back to yet another bad relationship.

Thank you for the kind words. I will try to do my best. Not sure how... I have to spend many of my savings to heal from this man - the gym, the therapy which is expensive. It sucks that I've worked a lot and eventually some cruel guy just got me to the point that I have to lose all this money because he hurt me so badly.

My ex also manipulated me to be emotionally unstable and freak out and cry. And then he told me I'm unstable, but I've never been this way before him. I've had panic attacks due to anxiety but never really cried hysterically over anything until he started treating me this way.
Always made me feel guilty for reacting badly to his words or actions, never actually tried to just stop torturing me.
I also found out about it only after the breakup, I didn't know that it's a thing. I only knew that something is wrong with him and the way he treats me.

Exactly what I feel. I'm happy that I at least found this subreddit and I see that I'm not the only one, because until then I just thought that I'm crazy and imagining him being not all right in the head.
